title: The caravan comes home, its stores lighter and its pilgrims changed. Word has run ahead of the camels, and crowds gather at Ishbīliya to welcome a ruler who stood before the Kaʿba. From this day the Emperor bears the title Ḥājjī, earned and not granted. Let it be known: Makka and back, by the grace of Allāh
